Real envelope is retained rather than a fabricated event ID. _independent checks exact context/vector/run, distinct actual three actors, recipient/sender and ordered execution/context/review/received/observed/intent timestamps.

Exact frozen baseline plus current dependencies; full _vector/product/_dispatches/_global/_independent and reader.finish invoked before ACCEPTED owner construction; pending owner explicitly IN_PROGRESS. Existing context/review/issuance roots refused, not silently replaced.

W07 appends three roots and preserves entire prior evidence prefix; every other state row unchanged. Checkpoint and ownership are derived from current captured objects, preserving 116 historical origin counters, preexisting parent records, W04 scope/bindings and latest revisions. Before each atomic os.replace, verify all three canonical hashes and frozen dependency snapshot; current target hash checked again. Original and desired bytes plus exact pending journal persist separately. Tested 0/1/2/3 write interruption restore against exact raw bytes.

Only own desired bytes may restore original bytes; external/missing targets preserved and reported PARTIAL_REGISTRATION; corrupted archive fails before writes; OS replacement refusal stays PARTIAL; completed transaction refuses rollback. New exception origins immutable and retained with explicit subsequent Root checkpoint reconciliation obligation.

Postwrite and final formal derivation require W07 VALID_ACCEPTED / A05 and input rechecks; actual parent ledger must independently include A05. Global PARTIAL from stale W04 is preserved. Historical parent registrations including gates-only entries are never presented as six fully current accepted parents.

After receipt serialization and final rechecks, fsynced completion bytes are linked atomically using exclusive os.link insertion. Pending journal/issuance/registration/handoff alone are not completion. Synthetic NTFS duplicate marker insertion refused and completion recovery refused.

required_operational_conditions: Root integrates this exact reviewed source SHA and uses its actual received-message argv; attestation authenticates external observation only because Root actually received it. JSON self-consistency alone is not delivery authentication.

Root serial registration lease must cover all canonical writers; per-file replace is atomic, not a simultaneous three-file filesystem transaction. Pending intent remains incomplete until completed.json; crash recovery is explicit and hash-bound.
Any new failure origin, including failed recovery, must be appended by Root on the next checkpoint reconciliation; exact rollback intentionally does not overwrite old counters to insert it.
Actual apply must revalidate current inputs. This SOURCE_READY review does not grant permission to bypass a later input drift or unsuccessful final derive/ledger/recheck.
